written.headline: Google Antigravity AI accelerates antimicrobial peptide discovery
written.summary: DeepMind announced that its agentic cheminformatics system, Google Antigravity, is being used to speed the search for antimicrobial peptides, according to a Science article in October 2026.

written.headline: StateBench benchmark reveals transformers struggle with long-context state tracking
written.summary: AllenAI introduced StateBench, a benchmark that measures how well language models track entity states over long documents. Tests show recurrent and hybrid models outperform frontier transformer models such as Gemini 3.8 Flash, Claude Opus 5.5, and GPT-6 Sol and Luna on harder state‑tracking tasks.
